text: why does bread dough need to rest before it goes in the oven

turns.content: Resting lets the gluten relax so the dough is easier to shape and doesn't spring back, and it gives the flour time to absorb the water and the flavour time to develop. A short rest after shaping also lets it puff up so the loaf bakes lighter.

text: I've run out of buttermilk, is there something I can use instead

turns.content: Stir a tablespoon of lemon juice or white vinegar into a cup of milk and leave it for five to ten minutes until it thickens slightly. Then use it one for one in place of the buttermilk.

text: how long should I boil an egg for

turns.content: Counting from when the water is boiling, about 6 minutes gives a soft yolk and 10 to 12 minutes gives a fully hard one. Run it under cold water afterwards to stop it cooking.

text: the kitchen sink's draining really slowly, how do I clear it

turns.content: Start with a plunger over the plughole, then try a kettle of hot water. If it's still slow, put a bucket under the U-bend, unscrew it and clear out the gunk, and avoid mixing different chemical drain cleaners.

text: what's a stud finder actually for

turns.content: It's a small handheld gadget that detects the timber or metal framing behind a plasterboard wall. You use it to find solid framing so heavy things like shelves or a TV bracket get screwed into something that will hold them.

text: how does a heat pump actually work

turns.content: It uses a refrigerant and a compressor to move heat rather than make it, pulling heat out of the outside air and releasing it inside when heating. Because it's only moving heat, it can deliver around three to four times as much heat as the electricity it uses.

text: why is the sky dark at night when there are so many stars

turns.content: Most stars are so far away that their light is too faint to brighten the sky, and the universe is only about 13.8 billion years old, so light from the most distant ones hasn't reached us yet. With the sun below the horizon there's nothing else bright enough to light it up.

text: is it okay to take paracetamol on an empty stomach

turns.content: Paracetamol is generally fine with or without food, as it isn't usually hard on the stomach. Stick to the dose on the packet, and ask a pharmacist or doctor if you have a liver condition or take other medicines.

text: what's the longest river in Australia

turns.content: The Murray River, at about 2,500 kilometres. It rises in the Australian Alps and runs out to the sea in South Australia, forming much of the border between New South Wales and Victoria along the way.

turns.content: It's Latin for seize the day, a reminder to make the most of the present rather than putting things off.

text: there's a little hole in my plasterboard from a door handle, how do I patch it

turns.content: For a hole up to a few centimetres, push in some premixed patching compound, let it dry, sand it smooth, then prime and paint. A bigger hole needs a self-adhesive mesh patch first, or a cut-in piece of plasterboard.

text: can I freeze leftover rice

turns.content: Yes, as long as you cool it quickly, ideally within an hour, then portion it and freeze it. When you reheat it, make sure it's steaming hot all the way through, and only reheat it once.

text: how does a microwave heat up food
